payload.title: The F4.0b minter census (I4) classes autonomy_orchestrator as escaped, but its generic queue prompt still places recommended_action and candidate_tools as raw JSON values outside any untrusted block, so the pending list that F4.0c drives to zero does not contain that minter
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/autonomy_orchestrator.py:358-365 (the generic prompt carries item.get('recommended_action') and item.get('candidate_tools') verbatim)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/autonomy_orchestrator.py:559 (the prompt is json.dumps'd straight into suggested_prompt, with no untrusted_block around those fields)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/task.py:300-304 (a finding mission's next_action embeds the finding's cited repository path)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:3013-3019 (the mission's next_action is queued as the item's recommended_action)
aria-kernel/tests/invariants/test_prompt_labels_one_owner.py:316-326 (the escaped-class check asserts only that the module imports a declared renderer, not that every field it mints goes through it)
payload.rule_violated: PLAN-v2 F4.0b I4: every minter is classified by where its prompt text comes from; a class that over-claims makes the 'pending may only shrink' pin end at zero while a raw path remains.
payload.notes: The census says the autonomy minter is escaped because its pressure and mission context goes through pressure_evidence.untrusted_context_fields. The same minter also puts the queue item's recommended_action and candidate_tools into the prompt unescaped; for a finding-sourced mission recommended_action holds a repository path chosen by whoever named the file. Because the module is not in the pending set, closing F4.0c by driving the pending minters to zero leaves this field family labelled nowhere, and no invariant fails. Close condition: Either route recommended_action and candidate_tools through untrusted_context_fields (or an untrusted_block) in autonomy_orchestrator, or class the minter 'pending' in MINTERS and raise the pinned pending count with the finding id in the same commit; add a test that renders the generic queue prompt with a hostile recommended_action and asserts it appears only inside an untrusted block. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
